testCase.name: [本地] S28 Wrong browser clock: a task ticked done is stamped and shown on server time, and the date header shows the server's day

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S28 「浏览器时钟错了：勾成完成的任务按服务器时间盖戳和显示，日期标题显示服务器的日期」 Wrong browser clock: a task ticked done is stamped and shown on server time, and the date header shows the server's day

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • G2 UAT 3.8: the stored doneAt, the day/visit shown on a closed task and the date header of the screen and of Copy Text follow server time, not the device clock（UAT 3.8） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-07；UAT 3.3；TFA-92585 AC 12） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Fresh @roundai.test account on the local stack; one open task on a Hospital patient and one on a Nursing Home resident on Today's Visits; the server's now and today from time:now

When In a Playwright context with context.clock.setSystemTime(serverNow + 24 h) — and a second run with serverNow − 24 h, and one with timezoneId 'Pacific/Kiritimati' for the header — tick the task done on /rounding/tasks and on /snf/tasks; read the task's doneAt through backend.query (rounding:list / snf:list); …

Then doneAt is within 5 minutes of server time in every run; the header date equals the server's today; after the lifecycle run the completed task is still listed (a −24 h stamp would clear it at once, a +24 h stamp would keep it about 40 h)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.8 (G2): every time-based rule uses the server clock. Predicted Fail on main: TasksOverlay.tsx line 110 stamps doneAt with new Date() and line 241 prints the header date with new Date(). S23 keeps the real-phone version

在哪跑：本地 newspec-b（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S28 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-07.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；Allure 状态按分诊从 failed 改成 broken。

问题分类：票没到 ready for qa · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92585 ready for pr

设备时钟慢一天时，刚打勾的任务记成昨天完成，下次打开列表就不见了，任务页的日期也显示昨天；快一天时，完成时间记成明天。

With the device clock a day behind, a task the physician just ticked is stamped as yesterday, disappears from the list the next time it opens, and the task screen is dated yesterday; a day ahead, done times are stamped tomorrow.

依据：newspec-b: at −24 h doneAt is −1440 min and the header reads 'Tue, Oct 13' (server day Wed Oct 14); at +24 h doneAt is +1440 min, and the saved session was refused first. Main stamps doneAt and the header with the device's new Date() (UAT 3.8 / TC-07 G2). Predicted in the TC-07 risks only. PR #106's TasksOverlay uses clockNow() (server-offset clock), so it is probably fixed there; recheck after the merge.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-b。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：newspec-b。

UAT item: TC-07 Task Export · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-07/S28

Wrong browser clock: a task ticked done is stamped and shown on server time, and the date header shows the server's day

Tickets: TFA-92585 Task Export (ready for pr)

本地新 lane newspec-b：newspec-b/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（newspec-b/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Chromium spec, fresh account, three runs: context clock serverNow+24 h, serverNow−24 h, and timezoneId Pacific/Kiritimati; tick the task on /rounding/tasks and /snf/tasks; read doneAt via rounding:list / snf:list; read the screen's date header; reopen lists so the lifecycle runs; open the task view again. — page.clock / timezoneId in our own spec (the agent runner cannot, the scripted spec can).

Detail:

Device −24 h: doneAt stored 24 h in the past (−1440 min vs server), header 'Tue, Oct 13' (server day Wed Oct 14), and on reopening the list the completed task is gone from the chart. Device +24 h: saved session refused; after signing in again doneAt +1440 min, header 'Thu, Oct 15'. Kiritimati, correct clock: doneAt within 0.05 min, header recorded (TC-11 Q4). Both modes alike.

产品问题：With a phone clock a day behind, a task the physician just ticked disappears from the list the next time it opens, and the screen is dated yesterday; a day ahead, done times are stamped tomorrow. Breaks UAT 3.8 / TC-07 G2 (stamps and dates follow server time). TasksOverlay stamps doneAt and prints the header with the device's new Date().

证据：附了 5 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A: our own planned Playwright spec (runnerGaps 9, not written yet) is local-stack only: a fresh account plus backend.mutation / backend.query need the admin key, which dev does not have, so the dev run leaves it to the local run (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
